evidence.snippet: The HTML to put one of SmartFin's free calculators on a website the user runs: a blog post, a class or library page, a client resources page. One iframe line, f…

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: smartfin_get_embed_code · Public sink: smartfin_project_savings_growth, smartfin_calculate_missing_variable, smartfin_calculate_present_value, smartfin_calculate_profit_margin, smartfin_get_embed_code.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: smartfin_get_embed_code · Public sink: smartfin_project_savings_growth, smartfin_calculate_missing_variable, smartfin_calculate_present_value, smartfin_calculate_profit_margin, smartfin_get_embed_code

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "smartfin_calculate_fire_number" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
